title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go, parity fixes, v1.91.0
author: Ava Kim
description:
Motivation: bring API parity and ergonomic defaults across all first-party SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go). This PR unifies auth flows (transparent token refresh and scoped credential behavior), standardizes retry/backoff defaults, improves streaming ergonomics (generator/async iterator APIs), and applies parity fixes discovered during cross-language e2e tests. Includes coordinated package version bumps to v1.91.0 and changelog updates.

Summary of changes: consolidate auth middleware/shared logic into sdks/common; add unified retry policy with idempotency-awareness and jittered exponential backoff; expose streaming helpers that provide consistent interfaces across SDKs (SyncIterator/AsyncIterator for Python, EventEmitter+async iterator for TS, channel/context-based streaming helper for Go); fix edge cases in multipart streaming and early EOF handling; update documentation and migration guide.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc linked (ENG-3421)
- [x] Implementation for Python, TS, Go
- [x] Unit and integration tests updated
- [x] Changelogs and migration notes added
- [x] Version bumps to v1.91.0

Backwards compatibility: no breaking changes to existing public method names, but streaming ergonomics provide additional helpers; migration doc included for teams that want the new iterator helpers.

Notes: There was one flaky e2e related to gRPC stream cancellation which required a minor change to server-side behavior (handled in a separate ops rollout). CI was re-run after fixing a flake in TS streaming tests.

discussion: Liam Carter (reviewer): Can we make the default retry window conservative for non-idempotent calls? Suggest special-casing based on idempotency flag.
Ava Kim (author): Agree. Implemented idempotency-aware logic in sdks/common; non-idempotent defaults use smaller retries and shorter overall timeout. Added tests.
Sofia Patel (reviewer): TS ergonomics look good. Two minor comments on types and Promise cancellation behavior.
Ava Kim (author): Addressed type comments and added a cancellation example to docs.
Diego Morales (reviewer): Go helper signature looks idiomatic but please ensure context cancellation propagates to underlying transport.
Ava Kim (author): Confirmed. StreamWithContext now cancels KV cache ops and closes underlying proto stream on context cancel; added unit test.
Liam Carter: CI flaky e2e is now passing after the suppression; approving for merge.
release_notes: v1.91.0: Unified SDK auth and retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go; new ergonomic streaming helpers (async iterator for Python, createStreamIterator+EventEmitter for TS, StreamWithContext for Go); idempotency-aware retry defaults; fixes for multipart streaming edge cases; small performance improvements; migration guide included.
